messages:
kai: Dropped a revised experiment into the playground: compact examples pill in schema editor + inline expansion in run history. Please quick-look for a11y + copy.

sam: Looking now. Quick questionare example snippets editable inline or open a modal?

kai: Inline editable. We wanted minimal context switching for devs iterating on prompts.

tess: Inline edit is nice. A couple of keyboard concerns: (1) pressing Enter currently commits and also inserts newline in textarea; (2) Esc doesn't cancel reliably.

anna: Agree with tess. Propose Enter = commit only if shift not held; Esc should revert to last saved value and move focus back to the examples pill. Also we need aria-live for the save result toast.

sam: UX nit: the pill label says "Examples: 2"  feels clunky in run history. How about "Show examples (2)"? It's more action-oriented.

kai: I like "Show examples (n)". Will update. Also added a small preview line under the pill when collapsed (first example truncated to 100 chars) so people can skim runs faster. Thoughts?

tess: Preview is helpful, but make sure the truncation adds an ellipsis and is accessible to screen readers (don't cut off mid-word). Use aria-label on the preview indicating "Preview of first example" with full text in an offscreen element.

anna: Color/accessibility: the pill uses token-neutral-200 on hover which fails contrast. Use token-primary-500 for focus/hover and token-border-strong for outline. I'll paste contrast numbers in a gist.

kai: Good catches. I'll swap tokens and add offscreen full-text for SR. Also will wire prefers-reduced-motion and set expand animation to 120ms.

deploy-bot: staging deploy completed: playground-examples-compact-1718805555 :white_check_mark: 

sam: I'll run a quick keyboard/VO pass tomorrow AM and leave results here. If we see more issues we can revert the inline-edit behavior.

tess: Copy idea: instead of "Edit" action on the inline row, use an icon button with tooltip "Edit example" and visible text fallback for small screens. Keeps the row tighter.

kai: Will switch to icon+tooltip with aria-label. Adding visible text for narrow breakpoints.

anna: One last thought: if examples are auto-suggested later, we should surface provenance (manual vs suggested) next to each example. Tiny label like "manual" / "suggested" with low-contrast badge. Impacts both copy and filtering in run history.

kai: Nice. I'll add a provenance badge placeholder. Thanks everyone, merging in ~45m unless anyone objects. Ping me if you want a demo before merge. :rocket:
